## Submission

- One PDF per team to Canvas, rendered from a Quarto document in the team's GitHub repo
- A URL to the 5–7 minute team video presentation
- Final commit pushed to GitHub repo by the deadline

**Due: Friday, June 26, 11:59 p.m.**

## Hard Requirements

Your report must meet **all** of these. Missing any one costs the associated rubric points.

- **Structure**: all sections in the required report structure, in order
- **Length**: ≥ 10 pages of body (narrative + figures + tables). Title page, references, and Code Appendix do not count
- **Figures**: ≥ 3, each with a caption, numbered cross-reference, and discussion in text
- **Table**: ≥ 1 non-trivial (summary/aggregated) table, captioned and cross-referenced
- **Multivariate figure**: ≥ 1 figure showing 3+ variables
- **Code**: in the Code Appendix only

## Rubric (100 points)

### Report Content (56)

| Component | Points | Done? |
|-----------|--------|-------|
| Introduction & Motivation — clear and engaging | 4 | [ ] |
| Research question(s) explicitly stated | 4 | [ ] |
| Data Provenance documented (source, collector, purpose, cases) | 5 | [ ] |
| Variables described and justified | 4 | [ ] |
| Data Wrangling & Cleaning explained in narrative (not just code) | 5 | [ ] |
| Non-trivial summary table (caption + cross-reference + discussion) | 5 | [ ] |
| Figure 1 (caption + cross-reference + discussion) | 4 | [ ] |
| Figure 2 (caption + cross-reference + discussion) | 4 | [ ] |
| Figure 3 (caption + cross-reference + discussion) | 4 | [ ] |
| At least one figure displays 3+ variables effectively | 4 | [ ] |
| Findings / Conclusions clearly stated and tied to question(s) | 6 | [ ] |
| Limitations & Future Work discussion | 4 | [ ] |
| Body meets 10-page minimum (narrative only; appendix/refs excluded) | 3 | [ ] |
| References / citations of data and sources | 4 | [ ] |

### Code Quality (15)

| Component | Points | Done? |
|-----------|--------|-------|
| Code runs cleanly (renders from scratch) | 5 | [ ] |
| Meaningfully commented | 4 | [ ] |
| Code in appendix, not body | 3 | [ ] |
| Reproducible from GitHub repo | 3 | [ ] |

| Component | Points | Done? |
|-----------|--------|-------|

### Video Presentation (10)

| Component | Points | Done? |

**Total: 100**

## Individual Adjustments

Project grades may be adjusted up or down by up to 10 points per individual based on oral checkpoints and observable team contribution. A student who cannot engage with the project at oral checkpoints will receive a lower individual grade than the team's collective work would suggest.

## Late Policy

Late work for the final project requires a request to the instructor at least 24 hours before the deadline, with evidence of progress and a proposed new deadline. Without prior arrangement, late final reports lose 10 points per 24 hours.
